verdict.rationale: Warp's site says it offers background jobs that run on a schedule or on events, ships default automations, and lets users write their own. It also describes Warp Agent autonomously handling onboarding, payroll, tax notices and benefits, logging every action and asking only when a decision needs the user. Automatic tax filings and payments across states support the same picture. Missing for 10: technical documentation on how custom jobs and triggers are authored and configured, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these automations run reliably unattended.
